title: When Should a VLM Look? Paying Only for Visual Calls That Were Needed and Used
abstract: arXiv:2609.22910v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-language agents that crop and zoom are trained with rewards that credit a successful tool call, yet a successful call does not show that the model needed to look or used the pixels it received. On our cold-start checkpoint only 10% to 12% of visual calls were both needed and used, and released agents make spurious calls 36% to 87% of the time on individual benchmarks. Outcome rewards, judge rewards, and branch probes each observe one side of this failure, and about two thirds of what an outcome reward pays goes to calls that were neither needed nor used. CounterCredit asks both questions of every image-returning call at its realized pre-call state, using the policy's own gold-answer score. A decision value compares the realized visual branch with answering immediately; an evidence value compares the returned crop with random same-size patches substituted into the same call. translated_title: VLM何时应该“看”？只为既被需要又被使用的视觉调用付费
translated_abstract: 摘要（arXiv:2609.22910v1，公告类型：新论文）：会进行裁剪和缩放的视觉语言智能体通常通过奖励来训练，这些奖励会将功劳归于成功的工具调用，然而一次成功的调用并不能证明模型确实需要查看，也不能证明它确实使用了所接收到的像素。在我们的冷启动检查点上，只有10%到12%的视觉调用同时满足“被需要”和“被使用”两个条件，而已发布的智能体在各个基准测试上做出虚假调用的比例高达36%到87%。结果奖励、评判奖励和分支探测各自只能观察到这一失败的一个侧面，且结果奖励所支付的费用中约有三分之二流向了既不被需要也不被使用的调用。CounterCredit在每次返回图像的调用的实际调用前状态下，利用策略自身的金标准答案得分来同时检验这两个问题：决策价值将实际的视觉分支与立即作答进行比较；证据价值将返回的裁剪图像与替换进同一调用中的随机同尺寸图像块进行比较。同时通过两项验证的调用可获得返现，而其余所有执行则……
tldr: 提出CounterCredit方法，通过“决策价值”（对比查看与直接作答）和“证据价值”（对比真实裁剪图与随机图像块）双重验证，只奖励既被需要又被使用的视觉工具调用，解决了视觉语言智能体中大量虚假视觉调用被错误奖励的问题。
en_tdlr: CounterCredit rewards only visual tool calls that pass both a decision value test (looking vs. answering immediately) and an evidence value test (real crop vs. random patches), fixing the widespread problem that most visual calls in VLM agents are spurious yet still get rewarded.
